name: KernelFrameVerifier
logic_name: Kernel frame source and proof verification

test_list.description: Return a source-derived fingerprint without appending activity.
Missing durable proof cannot complete a frame.
Changed source cannot invent a missing proof.
Require exact recorded result, approval and current source.
Validate real sandbox-transport fixture evidence, exact review binding, source invalidation and latest failure.

inputs.name: frame
inputs.description: Actual active frame identity supplied by the runtime driver.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Untrusted assistant output plus actual bounded tool results from the driver.

inputs.name: completion_request
inputs.description: Exact frame whose completion evidence the trusted host asks to validate.

output_description: A source-bound accepted step with only independently verified diff CIDs, or a separately validated opaque completion proof; no terminal frame transition is performed.
